Let \(t=\tan\alpha>0\). Since \(\cos(\frac\pi2+2\alpha)=-\sin2\alpha\), the equation is
\[
\sin^2\alpha-2\sin\alpha\cos\alpha=\frac{3}{10}.
\]
Divide by \(\cos^2\alpha\):
\[
t^2-2t=\frac{3}{10}(1+t^2).
\]
Thus
\[
10t^2-20t=3+3t^2
\]
\[
7t^2-20t-3=0
\]
\[
(7t+1)(t-3)=0.
\]
Since \(t>0\), \(t=3\).

\[
\boxed{3}
\]
